from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
import json,hashlib
root=Path.cwd();out=root/'reports/research/510300_treasury_borrowing_revision_source_qualification_v1'
assert not out.exists(),'已有E10目录，不覆盖注册。'
out.mkdir(parents=True);(out/'sources').mkdir()
protocol={'study_id':'510300_TREASURY_BORROWING_REVISION_SOURCE_QUALIFICATION_V1','experiment_id':'E10',
 'registered_at':datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat(),'phase':'FIXED_TWO_RELEASE_SOURCE_AND_ACCOUNTING_QUALIFICATION',
 'previous_goal_turn_classification':'PROGRESS_E9_FIXED_WEEKLY_CAUSE_REJECTION_AND_LEAF_ATTRIBUTION',
 'question':'同2023Q3净市场化私人持有借款预估修订，期初现金假设与期末现金目标分别贡献多少，剩余代表什么？',
 'fixed_releases':[{'publication_date':'2023-05-01','title':'Treasury Announces Marketable Borrowing Estimates'},
                   {'publication_date':'2023-07-31','title':'Treasury Announces Marketable Borrowing Estimates'}],
 'fixed_target_quarter':'2023Q3','source_unit':'billion_USD',
 'source_limits':{'primary_release_pages':2,'definition_support_pages':1,'locator_queries':1,'attempts_per_url':2,'do_not_retry_403_429':True},
 'calendar_support_rule':'若需定义只从上述原页脚注/链接定位一件官方说明，不改季度、日期或选取股票收益。',
 'fields':['同Q3净市场化私人持有借款预估','同Q3期末现金目标','Q3期初现金的此前预估（此前Q2期末目标）与后来实际Q2期末现金','修订原因原文及SOMA等定义','公布正文日期'],
 'decomposition':'借款修订=期末现金目标修订−期初现金修订+剩余私部门净融资需要修订。',
 'residual_boundary':'剩余不是自动的预算赤字修订；私部门持有口径可能含SOMA到期/其他融资安排，按原文说明，不强行分解缺值。',
 'source_gate':'两份同标题/实际日期原文、同Q3借款与现金范围、期初预估/实际及期末目标全部定位；缺字段结束，不填0。',
 'clock':'正文美国日末转上海只为保守公开日代理，不认证历史首版或当年收件。',
 'why_distinct':'E6为不同季度未来三月gross供给增幅，E9为已实现周均准备金构成；本题仅同一期事前融资计划更新的构成，不评分，不称市场共识意外。',
 'known_prior_evidence':'E6 May/Aug2023季度券规模声明已看过且提到SOMA/融资需求，E9历史与单例选择已知；不声明独立性或全仓此前未研究。',
 'reuse_check':'先读E6 2023Q2/Q3背景；此前定向8目录仅E6背景词命中。来源前不读新股票标签。',
 'equity_labels_allowed':False,'model_fitting_allowed':False,'account_backtesting_allowed':False,
 'new_fits':0,'new_accounts':0,'new_repository_code_edits':0,
 'new_prospective_forecasts_enabled':False,'orders_authorized':False,'current_view':'NO_VIEW','position':'UNSET','goal_achieved':False}
p=out/'protocol.json';p.write_text(json.dumps(protocol,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
parents=['reports/research/510300_fed_reserve_three_cause_weekly_score_v1/next_experiment.json',
 'reports/research/510300_fed_reserve_three_cause_weekly_score_v1/result.json',
 'reports/research/510300_multidim_treasury_long_supply_cause_score_v1/正文规模与原因摘录.json']
freeze={'registered_at':protocol['registered_at'],'before_new_borrowing_estimate_fields_or_equity_labels':True,
 'protocol_sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
 'parent_input_hashes':{rel:hashlib.sha256((root/rel).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for rel in parents},
 'mandate_snapshot':json.loads((root/'config/510300_existing_data_training_mandate_v1.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')),
 'scope_snapshot':json.loads((root/'config/510300_historical_cause_discovery_v1.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))}
(out/'freeze.json').write_text(json.dumps(freeze,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
print('E10两原文来源问题已注册；无股票标签、模型或账户。')
